name: bright-buttons
description: Coloured buttons and previews above the prompt for the paths in Claude's replies: left click opens (folders, media, 3D files and text: the system default app or one you choose), right click copies the path, hover shows the file name. Beside them, each switchable in the settings: a thumb that sends "Yes, please" in the chosen language, ⌾ for /advisor (right click: model for this chat), C for /compact with the prompt cache's time filling it (right click: compact when idle), H asking for a handover (right click: full handover mode). Windows, macOS, Linux. /bright-buttons or a right click on the thumb opens the settings.
